page.overview:
Who is Gloria Costello?

Stone Ocean. She is the sister of Ermes Costello and was killed on the orders of Sports Maxx 3 years prior to the story. Ermes purposely sent herself to Green Dolphin Street Prison in order to exact revenge.

Gloria Costello was an athletic young woman who had light semi-long swept-back hair save for two locks at the front. She was described as beautiful. Gloria has naturally arched eyebrows, noticably thicker in the interior half than at the exterior.

Gloria Costello was described as a lively and strong-willed individual. She also had a serious side, and was more of a mother figure than a sister to Ermes. Gloria constantly nagged Ermes to have her help at the restaurant. Confronted with a brutal murder on her steps, she initially chose to let the crime happen and never mention it, as she was attached to the restaurant, but Sports Maxx witnessing Ermes going away forced her to call the police to protect her sister.

According to others, she was lively and strong-willed, and was considered to be more of a mother figure to Ermes. Her only problem with her was, despite her beauty, she had no intention of marrying anyone. Speculation suggests it was due to her father getting old, and in turn she wanted to spend her life running the restaurant together with her little sister.
